acceptance: Shadow data on muse file-list SHIPs is compared with other reviewers' results
A decision: require a traced second reviewer, add a muse trace, or accept the risk with its documented reason
context: Shadow data so far (checked 2026-10-09): since #2760 merged (2026-10-08 18:30 UTC) muse ran in 7 oracle-review-shadow runs (37844575540, 37844862581, 37847792715, 37861958813, 37863646848, 37866366206, 37879106749), six as attempt 2 after the first reviewer, and each logged "slot 2: muse verdict". Whether any of those were file-list briefs, and whether muse's files_examined matched the files it was asked to read, is not yet checked.
description: muse (read_only: hard, reads_files: true) can take file-list briefs, but leaves no read trace, so only its own files_examined list and the citation check apply. muse is early in the low-medium and medium-high chains. agy cannot read files in headless plan mode (reads are denied) and stays disabled with reads_files: false. The decision record leaves open whether a muse or agy SHIP on a file-list brief needs a second reviewer.
